date_scope_check.qualification:
EA030-D1: The named district official’s account places election sealing 72 hours before 19 April polling, while the Assam Rifles account gives 17 April. These support 16–17 April bounds for the broader restriction; no inspected source supports 1 April onset. Mizzima distinguishes 17 April restrictions from complete closure around 17:00 on 19 April. This later tightening must not replace the broader restriction’s onset or imply a three-day complete shutdown.

Times of India and India Today NE explicitly date limited restoration to 20 April; the former reports around 13:00. This explicit event dating takes precedence over Northeast Live’s ambiguous publication-day word “today” on 21 April. Medical, student, emergency and selected essential-goods access was permitted, not unrestricted travel.

The proposed 1 May resealing was explicitly cancelled on 30 April, when Assam Rifles said the gate would remain open under the Free Movement Regime. No implemented May closure is inferred. A separate migration motive for this April election/security spell is not established.
